stem:
Which operation should be performed first when simplifying this expression?

40 \u00f7 (5 + 3) \u00d7 8 + 1

options.label: A
options.text: 40 \u00f7 5, because it is the first operation when reading left to right

options.label: B
options.text: 5 + 3, because the operation in the parentheses should be performed first

options.label: C
options.text: 3 \u00d7 8, because multiplication should be performed before addition

options.label: D
options.text: 8 + 1, because it is the first operation when reading right to left
